description: Template manifest for local Mail evaluation samples stored outside the repository. Keep only hashes, counts, format, and external-path references in Git.

privacyBoundary.reviewPathPolicy: Open evidence only from ~/.pact-server-data/evaluation-corpora/mail/; never copy message bodies, subjects, contacts, or attachment contents into the repository.
privacyBoundary.notes: The repository stores only redacted corpus metadata and external-path references.

openability.notes: Validate parser readability without storing message text in the repository.

structureAnchors.description: Thread grouping and message ordering remain traceable via external evidence.
Attachment count and media types remain attributable without persisting attachment contents in Git.

items.notes: Record only redacted counts and external evidence references; do not add message headers or body excerpts.
